## About
Air Repair Pros handles AC, heating and plumbing for homes in Frisco and the North Dallas communities around it. Our customer service team answers the phone any hour of the day or night, so a broken AC or a leak doesn't have to wait until morning.
Customers tend to remember the people who showed up. One reviewer wrote that Kes fixed a leaking toilet and clogged drains without taking long. Another thanked Glen F and the installation team for a smooth AC replacement.
We hold a 4.9 rating on Google from 5495 reviews.

## Services
- Air Conditioning: AC repair, installation and maintenance for homes in Frisco and North Dallas.
- AC Installation: New systems put in by our installation team. One customer had both their upstairs and downstairs units replaced in a day.
- Furnace Repair, Installation & Maintenance: Heating repair, tune-ups and furnace replacement to keep the house warm when it turns cold.
- Indoor Air Quality: Air filtration and purification to help control humidity and cut down on allergens at home.
- Plumbing: Leaky toilets, clogged sinks and shower drains, and water heaters. One reviewer said Steven is coming back for more work on their house.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do both HVAC and plumbing?
A: Yes. We handle AC, heating and plumbing.

Q: Can I call after hours?
A: Yes. Call anytime. Our customer service representatives are available 24/7.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Frisco and the other Northern Dallas communities nearby.

Q: Do you guarantee your work?
A: Our site offers a 100% satisfaction guarantee.

- "Edited to add: I changed it from 2 stars to 4 stars because the management team reached out and made it right and because of that we would reconsider using them in the future.

I wanted to share our experience. The night of July 3rd our AC stopped working so the morning of the 4th we called Air repair pros to come out. We were so glad they were able to come quickly and not even holiday, but we did not have a good experience.  We have two small kids so we could not wait until it was not a holiday/weekend for someone to come out. We knew we’d have to pay $130 just for them to come out, but they tried to oversell us dishonestly. In the first photo you’ll see that he told us “electrical components” needed to be fixed and it would be $1029. My husband and I talked privately and went back out to ask him what exactly needed to be fixed. It was then that he told my husband “ Capacitor, contactor, start circuit(compressor saver).” (I’m putting that in quotes because my husband wrote it in his phone as he was being told these three items.) My husband and I privately talked again, then the worker came in to talk to us. About 15 minutes into the conversation we found out the start circuit was something we didn’t even have to begin with, it was just recommended to extend the life of the other two items. I was growing concerned that first these items were originally quoted as a bundle issue and then to find out one wasn’t even a necessary repair. We asked him if there was any warranty on the work being done and if he could give us an itemized sheet of what was all being done with any details of work warranty on the sheet. What he gave us was the second screenshot. We told him we appreciate him coming out but we’d like to get a second opinion. He then kept saying “I can just change the capacitor.” Which is strange because first it was over $1k of work and now he can just change the capacitor? We ended up of course having to pay for the $130 holiday visit anyway and pay for another company to come out just to find out 1.) it was just the capacitor and 2.) the unit we have doesn’t need a start circuit. After the guy from Air Repair Pros left the company called us to follow up and told us they could come back and just change the capacitor. Which again reiterated to us that they were dishonest in the first place.

I’m frustrated we had to pay $130 for dishonest overselling.

I’m not even sure if I’ve even written a bad Google review before because I only like to write positive reviews, but I want to warn others that this might happen." (Elise Hoke, 4/5)
